# wallix-bastion_externalauth_radius (Data Source)

Get information about a RADIUS external authentication configured on the WALLIX Bastion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing RADIUS external authentication by name
data "wallix-bastion_externalauth_radius" "corporate" {
  authentication_name = "corporate_radius"
}

# Reference it from an authentication domain mapping
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "radius_mapping" {
  domain_name = "corporate.local"
  auth_domain = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_radius.corporate.authentication_name
}

# Output non-sensitive connection details
output "radius_server" {
  value = {
    host    = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_radius.corporate.host
    port    = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_radius.corporate.port
    timeout = data.wallix-bastion_externalauth_radius.corporate.timeout
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port` (Number)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `use_primary_auth_domain` (Boolean)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Key

`authentication_name` is the only Required argument and is used to look up the RADIUS external
authentication by its unique name on the Bastion. If no external authentication with that name
exists, the data source returns an error.

### Sensitive Field Is Never Populated

The `secret` attribute (the RADIUS shared secret) is marked `Sensitive` in the schema because it
can be configured on the resource, but the Bastion API **never returns secret material on read**.
This data source will always report an empty value for `secret` - do not rely on it to retrieve
the shared secret. If you need the shared secret in Terraform, source it from your own secret
management system rather than from this data source.

### Other Computed Attributes

- **host** / **port**: RADIUS server hostname/IP and port (typically 1812).
- **timeout**: request timeout, in seconds.
- **description**: free-form description configured on the resource.
- **use_primary_auth_domain**: whether the primary authentication domain is used for this RADIUS
  configuration.
